reason: Theorem with all four gates split into named dependencies: coercivity bounds the minimising sequence, reflexivity extracts a weakly convergent subsequence, weak closedness keeps the limit admissible, and weak lower semicontinuity makes it a minimiser. The countable selection of the minimising sequence is licensed by DC and the subsequence extraction by the published reflexivity corollary (ultrafilter lemma, DC, HB); both are stated in the item contract. Sources [T] Theorem 13.1, [MA] Theorem 2.4, [G] Section 4.1. Re-recorded because an upstream source citation changed; content unchanged.
